rationale: The discourse has become highly quantified and the parties now agree on the need for hard restructuring and on the relevance of risk-adjusted comparisons, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour and the state still reject closures/compulsory redundancies while management, owners, and investors still insist these instruments remain available. The last two rounds repeat the same positions with only procedural refinement, so further unguided rounds are unlikely to change the substance without an intervening evidentiary or mediation step.
